title: PyBELSA v1.0: Bayesian Epistemic Logic for Sustainable Aquifers — reproducibility archive
description:
Python implementation and reproducibility archive for the paper: 'An empirical crossover law for model-agnostic POMDP policies under transition-model misspecification' (Jakaite & Schetinin, 2026, Nature Machine Intelligence, under review).

Includes: BELSA framework (ELS_Phil_T, ELS_Int, ELS_Adapt), all ten benchmark environments (B1–B10), pre-computed Monte Carlo results (N_MC=200, SEED=2024), publication figures (Fig. 1–4), and a one-command reproduction script (reproduce_b10.py) for the headline result.
notes: Verified on Python 3.13, numpy 2.4.3, scipy 1.17.1, matplotlib 3.10.8. All pre-computed outputs included; no re-running required to reproduce paper figures.
